sources.entry: Quickeys - A mac menu bar app that provides note taking functionality though a quick dropdown menu.

summary.one_liner: Quickeys is a macOS menu bar app that offers quick note taking from a dropdown window toggled by a global hotkey.
summary.what_it_does: Quickeys runs as a menu bar app on Mac and opens a quick dropdown window for writing notes. The window can be toggled from anywhere with cmd+shift+8. Pressing cmd+enter searches the highlighted text, or all text if nothing is highlighted. Pressing alt/option+enter generates and copies a pastebin link for the highlighted or full text. The window can be resized vertically by dragging outside the text box and buttons, and notes autosave so they survive quitting the app. The README also says the app has other smaller hidden features beyond these.
use_cases: take quick notes from the menu bar
toggle a notepad with a global hotkey
search selected text from a notepad
share notes as a pastebin link
keep scratch notes that autosave on Mac
how_to_run: Install cocoapods with `sudo gem install cocoapods` or `brew install cocoapods`
Run `pod install` in the root of the cloned repository
Open `Quickeys.xcworkspace` in Xcode and let it restore Swift Package Manager dependencies
Click the Play button in Xcode to build and run the app
Alternatively, download the most recent release zip and drag it to the Applications folder, then unpack it
notable: Global hotkey (cmd+shift+8) toggles the window from any app
One-keystroke search of highlighted or all text
One-keystroke pastebin link generation and copy
Autosaves notes so they persist across quits
caveats: Pastebin functionality requires a local ApiKeys.plist file with an API key, which the README says is needed to run or contribute
README describes it as a mac app only, with build steps centered on Xcode and CocoaPods
keywords: take notes from anywhere on mac
